view.changed.ask: offer to fill it in, one short line

moves.doc: On an order's return form, tick an item of the order and set how many go back; opens the items step first when the form is on another one. 0 takes the item off. Refused with the order's items when the product is not on it.

args.name: product_id
args.doc: The order line's product id, as start_return gives it.

args.name: qty
args.doc: How many to return, 1 up to the number ordered (a numeral, "1", is read as 1); 0 takes the item off the return.

moves.doc: On an order's return form, ring one choice and choose it, as a tap does; the step that holds the field opens first (once the steps before it are complete). Nothing on the form is chosen before the shopper says it. Refused, with the field's values, when the value is not one of them, or naming what an earlier step still needs.

args.name: field
args.doc: A field of the return form by its name: reason, condition, resolution, exchange_variant_<product_id>, collection, pickup_window.

args.name: value
args.doc: One of the field's values as the form names them: doesnt_suit_room, unused_in_packaging, refund, pickup, weekday_morning; for exchange_variant_<product_id> the option value, Walnut.

moves.doc: Open a step of the return form the form has already reached, and ring it.

args.name: step
args.doc: A step already reached, 1 to 5: 1 items, 2 reason, 3 resolution, 4 collection, 5 review.

moves.doc: Validate the step in front like the Continue button and move to the next one. Refused, naming the missing fields.
Press Submit return, once the shopper has said yes. Refused, naming the step, while a step still needs something.
On the orders page, select one order: its status, items and the actions its status allows show, ringed.
On a packed order, press Change delivery day: the picker opens with the days it can move to, ringed. Refused when the order cannot move.

args.name: slot
args.doc: One of the order's authored delivery slots by id, d3-morning.

moves.doc: Open the order's delivery-day picker, ring the day and choose it, as a tap and Save do. Refused when the order cannot move (it is on the way or delivered) or the slot is not one it offers, with the slots it does offer.
Cancel a packed order, as Cancel order and its confirmation do, once the shopper has said yes. Refused once the order is on the way or delivered.
On an order that is on the way, press Request an earlier delivery: a request to the driver, never a promise. Refused when the order is not on the way.
On a delivered order, press Start a return: that order's return form opens on its first step, nothing chosen. Refused when the order is not delivered yet or is outside the 30-day window.

args.name: recipient
args.doc: Who it is for, by the gift edit's id.

args.name: occasion
args.doc: The occasion, by the gift edit's id.

args.name: budget
args.doc: A budget chip in dollars: 30, 50, 80, 100, 150, 250 or 500; 0 is No limit.

moves.doc: On the gift edit, ring each control given and set it, one after another, as taps do; the short list shows once who, the occasion and the budget (or No limit) are all set. Refused with the chips when a budget is not one of them.
On the showroom kiosk, leave the attract screen for the first question, as a tap on it does.

args.name: question
args.doc: A kiosk question by its id.

args.name: value
args.doc: One of its option values as content/kiosk.json names them: living, warm_wood, 400.

moves.doc: On the kiosk, ring an option tile and choose it; after the third answer the three picks and the QR code show. Refused with the options when the value is not one of them.
Clear the kiosk's answers and go back to the attract screen, as Start over does.

slices.doc: an order's return form: the order, the step in front, the field that just changed and its value (choices only, never personal data), and which fields hold something

fields.name: order_number
fields.doc: The order the return is for, FH-31042.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: The step in front, 1 to 5: 1 items, 2 reason, 3 resolution, 4 collection, 5 review.

fields.name: field
fields.doc: The field that just changed, by name.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Its value as the form names it (refund, doesnt_suit_room, a qty), or empty when cleared.

fields.name: filled
fields.doc: The names of the fields that hold something.

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: The return's reference, once submitted: RT-31042-1.

slices.doc: the gift edit's controls: who it is for, the occasion and the budget chip
the orders page: the order selected, its delivery slot by id, and what was just done to it
the showroom kiosk: the screen it is on (attract, room, feel, budget, picks) and the answer just given

events.note: {by} set {field} to {value} on the return form
events.doc: A field of the return form was chosen, changed or cleared.

events.note: {by} is on step {step} of the return form
events.doc: The return form moved to another step.

events.ask: thank them and say what happens next, in one line

events.note: {by} set the gift edit to {recipient}, {occasion}, budget {budget} dollars (0 is no limit)

events.doc: An order was selected on the orders page.
An order's delivery day was changed and saved.

events.note: {by} asked for an earlier delivery of {order_number}
events.doc: An earlier delivery was requested for an order on the way.
A delivered order's return form was opened.
The kiosk moved to another screen: attract, room, feel, budget or picks.
